scope: production SQLite repositories and provenance; server review input fixture, not real network or desktop proof
cases: narrow requests reject arbitrary text, foreign properties, duplicate fields, false acknowledgement and unsafe labels
review requires matching recording, unexpired context and bounded member scope
candidate authority and explicit pair required before persistence
all five checked fields use chosen label pair, affect members, preserve identities, emit immutable source and receipt
retention counts/history include release audit, use persisted ISO order and existing catalog records
catalog generic undo cannot bypass field confirmation
partial undo restores selected field and its previous provenance, preserving other online fields
